definitions.explanation: The rails and supporting structures on which trains run. The physical infrastructure of a railway.

examples.japanese: {線路|せんろ}に{入|はい}らないでください。
examples.english: Please do not enter the railway track.

examples.japanese: {線路|せんろ}の{工事|こうじ}で{電車|でんしゃ}が{遅|おく}れている。
examples.english: The train is delayed due to track construction.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}のころ、{線路|せんろ}{沿|ぞ}いの{道|みち}をよく{歩|ある}いた。
examples.english: As a child, I often walked along the road by the railway tracks.
examples.notes: 線路沿い = along the railway tracks

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {線路|せんろ}に{入|はい}る (to enter the tracks - dangerous)
- {線路|せんろ}{沿|ぞ}い (along the railway line)
- {線路|せんろ}{工事|こうじ} (track construction/maintenance)
- {線路|せんろ}を{渡|わた}る (to cross the tracks)

SAFETY WARNING: {線路|せんろ}への{立|た}ち{入|い}りは{禁止|きんし}されています (Entering the railway tracks is prohibited).

RELATED TERMS:
- {路線|ろせん} (route, train line)
- {軌道|きどう} (track, orbit)
- {踏切|ふみきり} (railroad crossing)
